title: I’ve hired +2000 people and the top candidates all do THIS
description: I've hired over 2,000 people in my career — and after reading thousands of resumes and sitting through just as many interviews, I’ve started to notice patterns. In this video, I’m breaking down exactly what the BEST candidates consistently do to stand out and get hired. Whether you’re job searching, switching careers, or just want to be more confident in interviews, these tips will help you feel prepared, empowered, and ready to land the job.
